name: Periwinkle Park Campground
note: Interior campground on Sanibel Island; not directly on the beach or bay. --AWH
why: Fort Myers family exception: 9 km from family (same basis as the named Fort Myers keeps)

name: Camelot RV Campground
fees_note: Full hookup $56 daily, $45 with the posted 20% discount for 2 people.
note: Family-owned park (since 1982) on US-60/67 at Poplar Bluff with 76 full-hookup sites (30/50A), cable and laundry; daily/weekly/extended. --Claude

name: Lake Pines RV Park and Campground
fees_note: 2023 rates: full hookup 30/50A $51 for 1-2 people ($45.90 Good Sam).
note: Family-owned private RV park (since 1966) on 20 wooded acres at 6404 Garrett Rd, Midland (Columbus area). Full hookups 30/50 amp, big-rig pull-throughs with concrete patios, plus primitive sites; pool, fishing, laundry, dump station. Transient nightly, reserve online/phone. Operating. --Claude

name: Drifters RV Park
fees_note: Full hookup $52.62 a day including tax, for 2.
note: Veteran-owned 21-site full-hookup RV park at 9110 Untreiner Ave, Pensacola. Large back-in sites 18 ft wide x 75 ft long; accepts big rigs. Transient (stays under 180 days), military/first-responder/Good Sam discounts. Reserve online.

name: Strawberry Fields For RV'ers
note: Transient/nightly RV park in Chiefland near Manatee Springs and Cedar Key; big-rig friendly spacious 30/50-amp full-hookup sites, bathhouse, laundry, community room, pickleball/shuffleboard/bocce. Nightly/weekly/monthly/seasonal rates; Harvest Hosts and Good Sam listed.
why: $60 tax included at a Good Sam Park; before tax less 10% is ~$48-50, too close to call

name: Queen Mine RV Park
note: Small in-town RV park (25 sites), the only RV park in historic Bisbee — walking distance to Old Bisbee, next to the Queen Mine tour. Level gravel back-ins that take larger rigs, full hookups with 30-amp, restrooms/showers/laundry. Reservations by phone; fills nightly in season. --Claude
why: $50 cash or check (at the gate, not over)

name: Pine Cone Camping
fees_note: 2026 overnight $75 per site, HST included; RVs only.
note: Large RV-only park (no tents) on Route 114 midway between Saint John and Moncton; 292 sites incl 258 full-hookup and 10 pull-thrus, two heated pools, free WiFi; open May 1-Oct 10; daily rate ~$60 CAD plus seasonal. --Claude

name: Butch Cassidy RV Park & Campground
note: RV park and campground at 1050 S State St (US-89) on the south side of Salina, about 40 sites. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
why: $56.25 includes taxes and fees; before them ~$50, too close to call

name: Aintree Trailer Park
fees_note: Two-point back-in C$71 (C$62.83 before HST), full service C$75 per night, tax included (2026). From our own note; not re-confirmed with the operator as of 2026-10-11.
note: Family campground in Kincardine a short walk from the Lake Huron beach: 150 seasonal sites (1-5 year waitlist) and about 21 overnight sites - two-point back-in (30A, water, up to 40 ft), full-service back-in and drive-through, small-trailer/tent sites. 2026 rates including tax: two-point back-in C$71 (C$62.83 before HST), full service C$75 a night; one night to a few months. Booked online, one-day deposit per week. Season 7 May-Thanksgiving Monday. --Claude
why: C$62.83 before HST (stored figure includes tax)
